annotations.text:
PRACTICE MODE — the hero.
Standing, guitar on, two metres from the screen, feet only. Six elements and nothing else: section, speed, reps, ring, lead-in, next rung. Three states, left to right.
SETUP MODE — sitting at the desk, mouse in hand. Ordinary density is fine here; none of it appears while you are playing.
CAPTURE is new since the first spec — records the machine's own output, splits a playlist on the gaps, matches segments to the tracklist by duration.
One accent (bronze). Semantic colour — green at target, terracotta cold/recording — is kept separate from it and always carries a word as well as a hue.
